items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: She has this great record out that’s based on sort of modern American poetry but it’s with this sort of octet and there’s you know Adrienne Rich or somebody else

ctx.x: Do you ever get away from your music room, your piano, your horn, and just walk and work on ideas? Even not on purpose.

Yeah. Yeah. I have been doing that a little bit more. It’s been hard to like (a) teach in college full time; (b) teach in college full time then with the Covid days and that really took a lot to just keep your spirits up to then be super creative in the middle of all of that. Some people have been. My hat is off to them. A lot of my friends, I don't know if you know the flute player/composer Jamie Baum. She’s somebody you might want to interview. She has this great record out that’s based on sort of modern…
